Free drawing app online

Rapier Draw opens a canvas in your browser. Draw with your finger on a phone, or with a mouse or a pressure-sensitive pen. Brush follows your pressure and speed. Select a shape to move, resize, label or restyle it, or attach an arrow that moves with it. Drawings are SVG: sharp at any size and editable later.

Questions

Can I draw on my phone?

Yes. Rapier is made for phones first: draw with your finger, and pinch to zoom.

Do I need to download anything?

No. Draw runs in your browser. There is also an Android app on Google Play.

Where does my drawing go?

Press Done and it goes into your document as an editable SVG. Save the document as one Markdown file, pictures inside.

Is it free?

Yes. Rapier is free and open source, with no account, ads or tracking.

Drawing

Draw with the brush in the formatting toolbar. Brush follows your pressure and speed. Select a shape to move, resize, label or restyle it, or attach an arrow to it that moves with the shape. Drawings are saved in the file as SVG: sharp at any size, editable forever.

Background makes beautiful adaptive SVGs you control with sliders. Aurora, topographic, textures, gradients and a lot more. Inside Draw mode, tap the canvas icon and then Background.
